summary: Separate critic supports the endpoint-corrected reduction relative to the stated imported unconditional coefficient lemmas and ordinary BV. The lcm squarefree tail, O(B^2) modulus multiplicity, noncoprime prime-power terms, strict moving endpoints, Mobius signs and short-h discard all check out. The root-authored supplemental local-factor proof is also supported: S(N)*(1-A(N)) is bounded below by c/log N uniformly, with order sharp and primorial asymptotic exp(gamma)/log N. No signed-operator or specialized bilinear cancellation has been proved, so Goldbach and any breakthrough remain unestablished. claims.text: The corrected decomposition G(N)=S(N)*(N-B_N)+O_N(N^theta)+O_{A,theta}(N/log(N)^A), for fixed theta<1/2, is supported relative to the inspected unconditional coefficient estimates and ordinary BV.
The supplemental bound S(N)*(1-A(N))>=c/log N is supported uniformly over sufficiently large even N, and its order is sharp along primorials with asymptotic constant exp(gamma).
A fixed maximal twisted discrepancy saving of exponent 2+eta at the stated complementary polynomial level is sufficient for the conditional closure, but that discrepancy estimate is not proved.
The near-cubic ordinary lower-sieve and specialized FI routes still lack the specified target-uniform distribution and parity-sensitive bilinear inputs.
The work supplies reductions and a sharper sufficient hypothesis, but no actual Goldbach lower bound, established breakthrough, effective finite closure, or verified novelty.
